missing: Specific NAS models a freelancer should buy to replace Dropbox. That means current prices for the NAS and drives, a real comparison of each brand's sync and remote-access apps (Synology Drive, QNAP Qsync, UGREEN), client share links, the total cost against Dropbox Plus/Professional over 2–3 years, and how each one handles CGNAT and setup.
why: No major reviewer or authority answers this. Only one page picks NAS hardware: itechguides, an Amazon-affiliate roundup with no testing that isn't written for a Dropbox replacement. The other readable pages either compare self-hosted software (Nextcloud, Seafile, Syncthing) with no device picks or are off-target. TechRepublic covers cloud alternatives, and the two Zapier results returned no text. A focused page that compares NAS boxes for a freelancer leaving Dropbox, with prices, sync-app comparisons and a direct pick, would stand out.
